description: This PHP file defines the vardefs (variable definitions) for the 'Spots' module in SuiteCRM. It includes metadata about the module's database table, fields, and relationships, as well as configuration for how the module behaves within the CRM.

classes.name: VardefManager
classes.description: A class responsible for creating variable definitions for SugarCRM modules.

methods.name: createVardef
methods.description: Creates vardef entries for the specified module, defining its fields and behaviors.
